frequencyWords.normalization: Parse word plus trailing integer frequency. Retain original candidate and Python lowercase variant if distinct. No accent folding, transliteration, inflections or phrase generation. Each accepted candidate must match MD5(UTF8(phoenix + candidate)) exactly. Full game Unicode lowercasing equivalence is not claimed.
